about: Coloxyl (docusate) tablets, by brand name only, are supplied six times from January to September 2026 to a 73-year-old woman.
Agarol (liquid paraffin) oral liquid is supplied three times from 15 January 2026 to 19 March 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, to a 70-year-old man.
The only laxative is Movicol (macrogol), which the source names as an alternative, and the only liquid paraffin is in Dermeze skin ointment, which is not taken by mouth, so the criterion is not met.
